description: This file contains unit tests for the DataReaderV2 class, which reads media segment data from shared memory buffers. It uses Google Test framework to verify correct parsing of media segments, including handling of optional parameters and encryption modes.

classes.name: Check
classes.description: Helper class to verify properties of parsed media segments, including mandatory data, optional data, and encryption details.

classes.name: Build
classes.description: Builder class to create different types of media segments for testing, including video, audio, optional data, and encryption configurations.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Reads a media segment of specified source type from shared memory using DataReaderV2.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes a media segment into shared memory buffer via IMediaFrameWriter.

methods.name: doSomeMessInMemory
methods.description: Corrupts shared memory to simulate parsing failure.
